newsitem.title: POLAND: SOCCER-WIDZEW LODZ V STEAUA BUCHAREST TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WIDZEW LODZ V STEAUA BUCHAREST TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's European Champions' League group B match between Widzew Lodz of Poland and Steaua Bucharest of Romania:

Widzew Lodz - 1-Maciej Szczesny, 2-Miroslaw Szymkowiak, 3-Tomasz Lapinski, 5-Pawel Wojtala, 6-Marek Citko, 7-Radoslaw Michalski, 8-Jacek Dembinski, 10-Ryszard Czerwiec, 12-Slawomir Majak, 15-Daniel Bogusz, 17-Andrzej Michalczuk.
Steaua - 23-Bogdan Stelea, 3-Roland Nagy, 4-Tiberiu Csik, 6-Daniel Prodan, 7-Marius Lacatus, 8-Damian Militaru, 9-Aurel Calin, 10-Adrian Ilie, 14-Tudorel Zamfirescu, 16-Ilie Miu, 22-Denis Serban.
